editorial:
Imagine falling in love with someone so much that you agree to break up before you even start college. That is the wild deal Clare and Aidan make. They want to enjoy every single moment together without the stress of long-distance fighting or heartbreak. The vibe is super sweet and a bit sad, making you wonder if a relationship with an expiration date is actually a good idea. You get to see their chemistry grow as they count down the days, which makes you really root for them even though you know the end is coming.

The acting feels natural, and the movie moves along at a nice clip. While the plot is pretty simple and follows some typical teen romance tropes, the emotional parts really hit home. If you enjoy stories about young love and big life changes, you will love this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the pretty scenery, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. If you are a fan of owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: During their final goodbye date, the couple realizes they cannot actually let each other go. They spend the night revisiting their favorite spots and admit that their pact was a mistake. Instead of breaking up to avoid pain, they decide to take a chance on a long-distance relationship. The movie ends with them choosing love over fear, deciding that being together is worth the risk of getting hurt later on.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt teen romances and stories about first love.
